approved_scope: Replace the validated C runner's dense prefill attention with native causal/sliding-window GQA over the existing Engine pages; preserve native decode, exact BF16 model math, CacheLayout, model/checkpoint, H100 target and fixed benchmark policy

attempts.hypothesis: Native GQA and sliding-window prefill can remove the existing dense page gather, repeated KV heads and explicit dense masks. This is an unprofiled static hypothesis; the parent owns the current-C profile and all performance measurements.
changes: Two FA2 BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper plans, prepared once per cache group/text forward and reused across all model layers

Query length greater than one selects native prefill; existing one-token native decode implementation unchanged
Bottom-right causal alignment over each chronological retained suffix, window_left=2047 for sliding layers and -1 for full layers
Live page counts and final live-page lengths exclude future reserved pages and unwritten final-page positions
Separate lazy 128MiB prefill workspace preserves the existing decoder's allocation and plans
Existing CUDA failure containment now also covers prefill before any layer mutates persistent KV
